title: Qualify Decode Throughput
determination: Decode throughput is adequate at the promoted baseline: the decode-limited workload classes measure inside/at the 9-11 tok/s band through the real agent (engineering median 9.29, short-answer 10.54). Below-band decode appears only on prefill/TTFT-limited classes (research 8.27, long tool-heavy 7.43) where decode is 20-23% of wall time, not the limiting factor. Runtime remains frozen; no decode optimization is opened by this step.

long-g1.note: rc=1 timed_out at 900s runner cap; partial

attribution.ttft_proxy_s: 11.6-15.8s across reps (first-task prompt eval + one token)
attribution.waiting_for_first_token: TTFT/prefill dominates short Q&A (48-59%) and research (75-78%)
attribution.waiting_for_generation: decode dominates engineering turns: 68-70% of wall
attribution.waiting_for_tools: tool-loop llama calls are the engine of prefill growth; not separately the bottleneck

answers.q2_short_answer_after_first_token: ~6-11s decode (59-114 tok at ~10.5 tps) after ~12s TTFT; total ~20-25s
answers.q3_engineering_answer: 92-162s total turn; decode 63-114s at 8.6-9.3 tps (68-70% of wall)
answers.q4_long_tool_heavy: >900s (did not complete within runner cap); decode ~190s (20%), prefill 709s (76%); decode at ~30k ctx = 7.4 tps
answers.q5_would_improvement_matter: Engineering: yes, decode is ~70% of turn — ~1.5x decode would cut ~20-35s/turn. Short: modest (TTFT-dominated). Research/long: little (prefill-limited).

optimization_decision: No further decode optimization opened: measured decode meets the promoted 9-11 band on decode-limited classes; heavier classes are TTFT/prefill-limited (Steps 10A/11 territory), not decode-limited. Runtime remains frozen.
limitations: long-g1 (94KB SERVICE-ROADMAP read) exceeded the 900s runner cap (rc=1) while still processing; decode was only 20% of elapsed time, prefill 76% — a context/tool-loop limitation for the production-state summary, not a decode failure.
Research (8.27) and long-context (7.43) decode measure below the promoted band but those turns are prefill-limited; decode improvements would not change their wall time.
Engineering decode sits at the low edge of the band (median 9.29, reps 8.61-9.33): decode is the largest single lever on coding-turn latency if interactive speed ever becomes the limiting factor.
